name: cycling-circle-taipei
description: 環騎臺北 騎乘資訊網站：風場/降雨/紫外線分析與順逆時針建議

scripts.preview:static: node --env-file=.env scripts/build-static.mjs && node -e "const h=require('node:http'),f=require('node:fs'),p=require('node:path');h.createServer((q,s)=>{let u=q.url.split('?')[0];if(u==='/')u='/index.html';const fp=p.join('web',u);f.readFile(fp,(e,b)=>{if(e){s.writeHead(404);return s.end('404')}s.writeHead(200,{'content-type':{'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.js':'text/javascript; charset=utf-8','.mjs':'text/javascript; charset=utf-8','.json':'application/json; charset=utf-8'}[p.extname(fp)]||'application/octet-stream'});s.end(b)})}).listen(8099,()=>console.log('靜態預覽 http://localhost:8099'))"
